headline: Approved FY2027 HUD budget, executive director contract extension, and multiple contracts, invoices, and change orders.
summary: The board approved the FY2027 HUD operating budget and a three-year contract extension with a longevity bonus for Executive Director Stephen G. Finn. It also approved payments, change orders, lease renewals, and procurement authority delegations, including a Rockland Trust loan transfer, Southcoast change orders and completion certificate, DEIULIS final payment, MVAS invoice and MOU, Malden Police Department invoices, and performance bonuses for staff who repaired a drain line at 557 Pleasant Street.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the 8-11-26 meeting.
Approved Resolution 2026-11 for MHA's FY2027 HUD Budget and related certifications.
Approved Resolution 2026-12 for a three-year contract extension for Executive Director Stephen G. Finn with a 15 percent longevity bonus.
Approved transferring up to $1,200,000.00 from Eastern Bank to Rockland Trust's MHA EPC Loan account for FY2027 monthly payments.
Approved delegating procurement authority to Randy Waters to issue purchase orders up to $49,999.00 and updated credit limits for other staff.
Approved the MOU between MHA and Mystic Valley Aging Services for a Supportive Housing Service Coordinator for Forestdale Development.
Approved adopting HUD's CY2027 Passbook Rate of 0.38% effective 01/01/2027.
Approved Resolution 2026-10 payment of $695,053.87 to DEIULIS for the Forestdale ModPhase Project.
Approved two change orders from Southcoast totaling $67,880.91.
Approved performance bonuses for MHA staff for work on the 557 Pleasant Street drain line repair.
Approved writing off all vacated tenant balances through 8-21-26 with collection recovery at Attorney Danielle Walsh's discretion.
Approved the lease renewal and rent increase for 13 Rockland Ave with Elliot Community Human Services.
Approved payment of $16,585.00 to MVAS for Resident Service Coordinators.
Approved payment of $4,386.07 to the Malden Police Department for nine invoices.
Approved the Certificate of Substantial Completion from Southcoast for the Suffolk Manor stove to electrification project.
Accepted two EOHLC awards totaling $20,691.00 and $56,083.00 for water conservation projects at Forestdale.

decision_evidence.quote: VOTED: To approve the 8-11-26 meeting minutes.

RESOLUTION 2026-11 To approve MHA's FY 2027 Budget together with authorization and approval for Board Chairperson, William P. Hurley, to sign and submit MHA's FY2027 HUD Operating Budget Resolution form HUD-52574

RESOLUTION 2026-12 To approve three (3) year extension to the contract of employment between the Malden Housing Authority (MHA) and Stephen G. Finn, as Executive Director... additionally to approve a longevity bonus for Executive Director, Stephen G. Finn, in the amount of fifteen (15) percent on his salary each year for the duration of his three (3) year extended contract.
VOTED: To approve the Finance Director to transfer up to $1,200,000.00 from Eastern Bank to Rockland Trust's MHA EPC Loan account to make monthly payments on the obligation during FY2027.

VOTED: To approve delegation of authority to Modernization Director, Randy Waters, to issue PO for amounts up to $49,999.00 in the HAB system along with approval and authorization for changes/additions to the Executive Directors delegation of procurement authority as detailed above pursuant to MHA's Procurement Policy.
VOTED: To approve the MOU between MHA and MVAS as detailed above with cost paid by the COCC/State program or otherwise as determined by the Finance Director.
VOTED: To approve and adopt HUD's CY2027 Passbook Rate of 0.38% as MHA's Passbook Rate as detailed above for FY2027 with an implementation date of 01/01/2027 for all applicable programs.

VOTED: To approve payment of Application for Payment and Certificate of Final Completion in the amount of $695,053.87 from DEIULIS for work on the Forestdale ModPhase Project with cost paid by the State through CapHub.
VOTED: To approve two (2) change orders as detailed above totaling $67,880.91 from with cost paid by the CFP.
VOTED: To approve payment of performance bonuses to MHA staff as detailed above with cost paid as determined by the Finance Director.
VOTED: To approve to write off all vacated tenant balances through 8-21-26 with collection recovery at Attorney Danielle Walsh's discretion.

VOTED: To approve FY2027 EOHLC 689 Program renewal of the lease with Elliot Community Human Services for 13 Rockland Ave and to increase the rent from $3,022.72/month to $3,107.35/month effective 10/01/2026
VOTED: To approve payment in the amount of $16,585.00 to MVAS as detailed above with cost paid by the AMP's served.
VOTED: To approve payment in the amount of $4,386.07 as detailed above to the Malden Police Department with cost paid by the AMP's served.
VOTED: To approve Certificate of Substantial Completion from Southcoast as detailed above and authorize Executive Director to sign same to close out project.

VOTED: To accept two (2) awards from EOHLC SUST -FY26 Water Conservation, the first in the amount of $20,691.00 for Forestdale 667-1 and the second in the amount of $56,083.00 for Forestdale 667-3 for the replacement of inefficient toilets.
